about: What the shadow truck hits in BeamNG, chosen by ATS impact speed. One row = one tier in the generated Lua table.

columns.min_kmh: lowest ATS impact speed for this tier (inclusive)
columns.beamng_model: BeamNG vehicle/prop model id, loaded from the player's own BeamNG install
columns.beamng_config: config name inside that model, or 'default'
columns.ahead_m: metres in front of the shadow truck's nose where it is placed
columns.label: text shown in BeamNG
columns.verified: design | game (spawned and hit in BeamNG)
